page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, which consists of 47,244 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The instance does not include any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1.4xlarge offers high storage density per resource unit, making it a viable option for workloads requiring massive local capacity without the premium cost associated with solid-state drives. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. This hardware profile is suited for storage-intensive workloads, large-scale data warehousing, log processing, and distributed file systems that benefit from high-capacity local HDD storage.
